members.name: volume_momentum_v1
members.thesis: Volume-weighted momentum measures not just how much price moved, but how much volume participated in the move. When ROC(10) is positive AND cumulative volume on up-bars exceeds cumulative volume on down-bars by >60:40 over the last 20 bars, the momentum has institutional backing (large volume confir
filters: integrated into the signal — vol_ratio_20 IS the volume filter
VWAP alignment ensures we trade with institutional flow, not against it
weaknesses: The up/down volume classification (close > open) is crude — a bar can close green on low volume and red on high volume
20-bar lookback means the volume ratio can be distorted by a single extreme-volume bar
In low-volume periods (lunch hour 12:30-13:30), the ratio is based on thin data and unreliable

members.name: order_flow_imbalance_v1
members.thesis: When buy volume (volume on uptick bars) significantly exceeds sell volume (volume on downtick bars) over a 10-bar window, aggressive buyers are dominating. This volume delta predicts near-term price direction for 5-15 bars. The inefficiency exists because most retail platforms don't display volume d
filters: no trades first 10 min or last 15 min
skip if spread > 0.06% (tight spreads required for scalps)
weaknesses: Volume delta using close vs open is a crude proxy — true order flow needs tick data
Very tight target (20 bps) vs costs (12-15 bps) means net edge is thin
High frequency (up to 12 trades/day) amplifies brokerage costs significantly
